title: Mordheim KB warband — special-rules.yaml
description: The editorial special rules of a warband: the source prose plus its machine classification. A rule keeps its own id and declares equivalence by sharing a binding, never by repeating prose. Shared definitions live in defs.schema.json.

band_id.description: Band the rules belong to; must match the directory and `band.yaml`.

rule.description: One special rule: prose (its own `effect` or a `rule_ref` to shared text) plus the runtime classification.

effect.description: Canonical English prose of the rule, reviewed against the source.

rule_ref.description: Id of a shared rule in `catalog/rules/special-rules.yaml` whose text this rule reuses; it replaces `effect` and is only set after an equivalence review.

kind.description: What a `selectable` rule lets the player choose.

applies_to.description: Who the rule is granted to at least one of: the whole band, or specific profiles.

eligibility.description: Profile ids allowed to take the rule when it is selectable.

summoned_profile_id.description: Profile the rule summons, when it does.

summoned_count.description: How many models the rule summons, as a dice expression such as `1D3`.

runtime_selectable.description: Legacy flag superseded by `runtime.grant: selectable`; kept until the editorial pass removes it.

skill_category.description: Legacy free-form skill category of the rule; kept until the editorial pass removes it.

oneOf.description: The rule carries its own prose.

allOf.description: A selectable rule must declare what type of choice it is.
